integrity: Self-contained algebraic proof and a standard-library finite-instance verifier. No independent mathematical audit or external certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite commutative principal ideal rings only; the disconnected two-field case has no finite Wiener index. Small-ring computation supports but does not replace the general proof. Equivalent earlier comparability-graph enumerations could exist outside inspected sources.
title: Three-distance law and Wiener polynomial for annihilator-inclusion graphs of finite principal ideal rings
